tagline: Industrial real estate in six major coastal U.S. markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Represents 80.5% of the company's total annualized base revenue, reflecting the company's strategic concentration in warehouse and distribution properties within its industrial real estate portfolio

kpis.name: Warehouse and Distribution Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from warehouse and distribution properties
kpis.description: Represents 80.5% of the company's total annualized base revenue as of December 31, 2025
kpis.signal: Represents the majority of the revenue portfolio

kpis.name: Total Annualized Base Rent
kpis.explanation: Total annual rental income from properties
kpis.description: Includes revenue from warehouse and distribution (80.5%), flex (3.4%), transshipment (6.0%), and improved land (10.1%) properties

kpis.name: Number of Buildings
kpis.explanation: Total number of buildings owned by the company
kpis.description: Includes warehouse and distribution, flex, transshipment, and improved land buildings as of December 31, 2025
kpis.signal: Diversified portfolio of 309 buildings including one held for sale

kpis.name: Total Square Feet
kpis.explanation: Total square footage of buildings owned by the company
kpis.description: Includes warehouse and distribution, flex, transshipment, and improved land buildings as of December 31, 2025
kpis.signal: Significant real estate portfolio of approximately 19.8 million square feet

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Occupancy rate of buildings owned by the company
kpis.description: Buildings and improved land parcels were approximately 96.1% and 95.4% leased, respectively, to 683 tenants as of December 31, 2025
kpis.signal: High occupancy rate indicating strong leasing demand

kpis.name: Improved Land Parcels
kpis.explanation: Number of improved land parcels owned by the company
kpis.description: 46 improved land parcels comprising approximately 147.0 acres as of December 31, 2025
kpis.signal: Strategic land portfolio for future growth

kpis.name: Properties Under Development or Redevelopment
kpis.explanation: Number of properties currently under development or redevelopment
kpis.description: Six properties under development or redevelopment that will include nine buildings totaling approximately 1.2 million square feet
kpis.signal: Development pipeline offering potential value creation

kpis.name: Number of Customers
kpis.description: 683 customers with the largest customer representing approximately 4.9% of total annualized base revenue as of December 31, 2025
kpis.signal: Customer base diversification with largest customer representing 4.9% of revenue

risks.title: Risks related to real estate acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first in risk factors, language is strong ('poses risks', 'could harm'). Acquisition is central to growth strategy. High weighting for 'Industrial' in real estate.

risks.title: Tenant dependency and default risk
risks.score_rationale: Strongly emphasized with details on bankruptcies, defaults, and legal limitations ('dependent on tenants', 'bankruptcy or insolvency', 'substantial costs'). Credit is a key category for rental real estate.

risks.title: Sector concentration and economic slowdown
risks.score_rationale: Risk of concentration in industrial real estate is explicitly stated ('concentrated in the sector', 'to a greater extent'). A sector-specific economic slowdown would have a major impact. 'Industrial' category relevant.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT systems risks
risks.score_rationale: Detailed with mention of increasing frequency and sophistication of attacks, including AI ('risks associated with security breaches', 'increasing number, intensity, and sophistication'). Cybersecurity is critical for operations.

risks.title: Uncertainty of distributions and legal constraints
risks.score_rationale: Risk is clearly stated ('availability and timing uncertain', 'limited by law'). Ability to distribute funds is crucial for REIT investors. Appropriate 'Capital' category.

risks.title: Pandemic and infectious disease risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned as a potential risk ('any future pandemic', 'adverse effect'). Impact is uncertain but potentially significant on operations and tenants. General 'Macro' category.

risks.title: Development and redevelopment risks
risks.score_rationale: Describes inherent risks in development projects ('may not perform as expected', 'higher costs', 'delays'). These projects are important for future growth. Relevant 'Industrial' category.

ai_positioning.summary: The company TRNO does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
